findings: PQ2_0 tg 0.32 -> 1.35 t/s (4.2x), bit-exact, coherent output. PQ2_0 is now the FASTEST Bonsai 2 band on RK3588, ahead of PTQ1_0 (0.86) and higher precision (2.16 vs 1.75 bpw).

Root cause (found by profiling): PQ2_0 weight matrices (ne[0]%256==0) dot against Q8_K, and ggml_vec_dot_pq2_0_q8_K was scalar-only on ARM (88% of decode). The q8_0 variant I'd examined earlier was not the hot path.
Fix: NEON ggml_vec_dot_pq2_0_q8_K (2-bit vqtbl codec; Q8_K single per-256 scale -> one int32 accumulator, scaled once). Microbench 5.36x over scalar on A76.
Re-profile @1.35: kernel 73%, ~19% barrier spin. 2-bit codec near-minimal; remaining headroom is the barrier floor (same as PTQ1_0). Stopped - diminishing returns.
Recommendation flip: PQ2_0 is now the best band for this board.

config.goal: optimize Bonsai 2 PQ2_0 tg on RK3588
